name: pg_describe_table
description: This tool allows you to describe a PostgreSQL table: its columns with types and nullability, primary key, foreign keys, indexes, and any check constraints. Use this tool before writing queries against a table you have not seen in this session so that column names in your SQL are exact. The description reflects the current committed schema; uncommitted DDL from other sessions is not visible.

table.description: Name of the table to describe.
